title: 最后一颗火种
style: cute healing fantasy, soft warm glow in darkness, cinematic lighting
story: 小灯灵 Lumo 在废墟城市发现一颗微弱火种，一路保护它。途中遇到寒冷的雪怪、废弃机器人和失去家的小女孩。最后发现：这颗火种不是太阳碎片，而是一个孩子心里的希望。

clips.image_prompt: a tiny palm-sized glowing light fairy with a round chubby body, a small glowing wick on her chest, a long yellow cloak flowing to the ground covering her feet, big bright eyes, holding a large lantern bigger than herself, kneeling down discovering a faint glowing ember on a ruined city street at night, dark ruins, soft warm light
clips.motion_prompt: subtle motion, gentle glow pulsing, slight head tilt
clips.voice: 很久以前，世界拥有太阳。直到有一天，它熄灭了。
